text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The air around here... kind of reminds me 
of back home.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Queen Stakes is held at Sapporo 
Racecourse. Perhaps because it felt 
similar to Morioka, Yukino Bijin was 
completely relaxed.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, isn't that girl... the one who's 
really popular in Tokyo right now?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, "Snow Angel"-chan?! It really is, so 
cute~. Oh, right, she's racing here 
today~.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll stay and watch the race? I'm 
curious to see how they run!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um! Please, do come and see!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Before the race, Yukino Bijin was 
completely tense and stiff."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
First off, we gotta win over everyone's 
hearts around here!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If we do, then... we can change things at 
the Shuka Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna win, absolutely no doubt about 
it! Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list: Swaying from side to side from there~

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Somehow, my head feels totally clear!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list: Let's win this and build some momentum!
